desc: mine happy path — a small surface iron cluster the SCAN-driven mine mission finds + drains. Success = ORE_FOUND (SCAN located the cluster and the bot mined it), no ERROR. NOT WAYPOINT: the vein-marker record is deduped against existing 'vein' waypoints within cfg.scan.veinRadius (persistence.ts), so on a repeat run the prior run's persisted marker suppresses a fresh WAYPOINT — a state-dependent side-effect, not a reliable per-run behavioral signal (removed; the persistence layer has its own vitest coverage).
